findings.fact: Default max_atoms is128; heavy atoms are randomly cropped with numpy.random.shuffle above this count. Hydrogens are removed unconditionally in mol2unimolv2.
findings.required: Bind actual heavy-atom coverage, retained atom indices, crop RNG and policy. Prefer no silent crop in the initial representation contract; any oversized failure stays in the original row map. Larger full-molecule limits need an explicit resource-tested choice.

findings.fact: UniMolRepr accepts kwargs but does not propagate them into self.params; max_atoms, seed and multi_process passed as extra kwargs are not honored through this constructor.
findings.required: Use an explicit verified adapter/config route instead of assuming these kwargs change preprocessing. Record actual downstream parameters.

findings.fact: The SMILES path uses seed42, with3D/2D fallback. The atoms-and-coordinates input route builds a molecule containing atoms and a conformer but adds no bonds.
findings.required: Do not reuse a Monroe coordinate array through atoms-only input and call it equivalent molecular input. Reuse full molecule connectivity/stereochemistry or construct features from original SMILES and validated coordinates. Record geometry branch explicitly.

findings.fact: Representation mode calls is_train=False, so an invalid SMILES raises. The V2 feature pool processes up to8 workers by default.
findings.required: External row-preserving wrapper must isolate invalid inputs, retain duplicates/failures, and honor task CPU limits; no data cleaning that removes evaluation rows.

findings.fact: Import overwrites HF_ENDPOINT with hf-mirror.com; default weights live under the installed package and model construction can download automatically. Loader defaults strict=False without asserting full representation-key coverage.
findings.required: Explicit task-local pinned checkpoint and dependency roots, no automatic network/mirror changes, checksum verification, safe loading and complete pretrained coverage of the actual representation path. Any unused random classification head must be named and proven bypassed.

findings.fact: Pair tensors scale with padded atom count squared and512 pair channels. Actual non-DDP inference uses eval plus no_grad and no autocast context, despite a generic trainer AMP setting.
findings.required: Start with a bounded small batch, record actual dtype and memory, explicitly no pretrained optimizer or adaptation. Do not infer mixed-precision execution from the trainer AMP flag alone.
